issue.title: Bare bob ref shows the reading queue instead of help

task_type_fields.proposal:
Make bare `bob ref` (no subcommand) show the reading queue, as `bob ref list` does, instead of printing help. Proposed by phase bob-cli-4w.11 (note #5) of epic bob-cli-4w, recorded by bob-cli-4w.land.

Epic bob-cli-4w's design decision 1 kept "Bare `bob ref` keeps printing help" (`src/native/highlights_ref/cli.rs` `build_cli()` / `highlights_ref::run` dispatch). Defaulting to `list` would match the "what am I reading?" use and other default-run groups like `bob vault-sync` (default: run). It needs a decision on the parent `-n/--no-hooks` option and on whether `bob highlights` / `bob highlights-ref` (permanent argv-prefix aliases in `src/runner.rs` `ALIASES`) should also change, since external callers (cron, hooks) invoke those aliases.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: It reverses an explicit epic bob-cli-4w design decision (bare `bob ref` prints help), so it needs Bryan's call rather than a land-time change.

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-4w.11 proposed it as a follow-up; it would reverse epic bob-cli-4w's explicit decision that bare bob ref prints help.
